preconditions.description: The number of points n must be between 2 and 2000 inclusive.
The threshold k must be between 1 and 10^9 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'no solution' if n * (n - 1) // 2 <= k else any((x1, y1) != (x2, y2) for i in range(n) for j in range(i + 1, n) for x1, y1 in points for x2, y2 in points)
postconditions.description: If the total number of pairs is less than or equal to k, output 'no solution'; otherwise, output n distinct points such that the total operations exceed k.

postconditions.expression: all(abs(x) <= 10**9 and abs(y) <= 10**9 for x, y in points)
postconditions.description: All coordinates of the points must be within the range of -10^9 to 10^9.
